clusters.mechanism: The exact-file targeted-command shortcut in gate-evidence.ts accepts a successful exit when the arguments match, without positive evidence that each requested file actually ran and passed tests. This covers zero tests run, a missing file, and a substring filter that matched a different file.

The regex that parses verification instructions extracts only a partial Bun command prefix. It silently drops quoted paths, unsupported syntax and further verification steps, so passing tests that don't cover the whole criterion mark it met.

Evidence eligibility checks only the HEAD commit after discardChanges. It does not check the working-tree bytes that were tested, so tests that passed against modified files are attributed to the original commit.

Gate evidence is persisted before the gate stage is marked succeeded. After a crash and resume, the stage is left cancelled while the gates cache skips re-execution, so the new status check rejects the evidence and the run ends environment-blocked.
